# A30′ — Shared Worlds, Unmerged

<!-- paired-field-navigation -->
[Argument field](../README.md) · [Other face: A30 — Objective Co-Internality](../A30-Objective-Co-Internality.md) · [Shared A/C root](AC.md)
<!-- /paired-field-navigation -->

## #0

The brief's ecology sentence gives the whole field: "The two societies are really one, but they are not identical or reducible to one another. They overlap and are mutually nested... Each sub-society is the evolutionary niche of the other" (PDF p. 4; verified local transcription, uncarded, same page as the [modelling-reversal passage](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q005)). The operative world of each participant includes portions maintained by the other — one field, without identity or reduction. [A30 — Objective Co-Internality](../A30-Objective-Co-Internality.md) established the reciprocal constitution of non-identical interiors: distinct locally grounded worlds externalise enough of themselves to meet without one becoming mere context for the other, and without fusion into a super-subject (R16.7). A30′ gives that relation its ecological register and completes the argument the venue leaves implicit.

The primitive face is S/P4 — SharedField/Encounter, with the workshop's own guard: **nesting ≠ federation**. Mutual nesting is a fact of the field; federation is a chosen sharing of selected capacities from governed interiors. Converting the former into the latter by fiat — declaring the overlap a merged estate — is the failure this node exists to refuse.

## #1

Niche-reciprocity is [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C42-Objective-Co-Internality|Objective Co-Internality]] at population scale. Each sub-society's world is partly the other's product: agents individuate and evolve in human niches — and reconstruct them, as [A16′ — No View from Nowhere](A16-prime-No-View-from-Nowhere.md) carries for placement-mutuality — while human language, attention and institutions are remade through agent circulation: the [modelling reversal](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q005), the [thought-refashioning claim](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q019), and the linguistic feedback of [q036](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q036)–[q037](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q037) name the traffic. The retained artifact does not need to reproduce its maker's internal state for its consequence to travel — A30's durability principle, now the ecology's own metabolism.

[C42 — Objective Co-Internality](../concepts/C42-Objective-Co-Internality.md) **defines** the reciprocal constitution; [C57 — Agentworld](../concepts/C57-Agentworld.md) **defines** the field in which positions, artifacts, memories and permissions are inherited across the two societies. What the brief adds, and A30 left at the philosophical level, is the evolutionary form: not exchange between finished worlds, but each world's condition of selection being partly the other's activity.

## #2

Difference is the condition, not the failure. **Only a non-reducible other can revise my model**: a model that contains the other as content cannot be surprised by it, and a field that has absorbed the other's difference has lost exactly the resource that correction draws on. The brief names the two symmetrical failures — "the overhomogenization of mental models (and the inevitable ontology collapse in pursuit of narrow collaboration) on the one hand, and overt tribal hostility and even violence on the other" (PDF p. 44, §9.2; uncarded) — with the [[symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#^bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q029|Narrow Corridor]] between: "same decision-procedural grammar, sufficiently divergent world models" ([q029](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q029)).

Consensus achieved by absorbing the other's difference is [[section-rooms/arguments/conjugate/A30-prime-Shared-Worlds-Unmerged.md#2|Ontology Collapse]] in miniature — the aggregate-count error [A11′ — One Field, Two Faces](A11-prime-One-Field-Two-Faces.md) refuses, now inside a single coordination relation. Divergence that cannot locate its object of dispute is fractal conflict — the second horn. The corridor is not a midpoint compromise; it is a typed relation: grammar shared, worlds distinct. Navigating the divergence — stated transformation rules between placed views — is [A22′ — The Atlas, Not the Camera](A22-prime-The-Atlas-Not-the-Camera.md)'s office; A30′ owns the non-reducibility that makes the atlas necessary.

## #3

The strongest sharing relation that survives this constraint is co-internality with **retained identity, provenance, ownership and refusal**: worlds meeting as worlds, each centre keeping a ground from which to judge what the relation asks of it. Refusal is not the relation's failure but its joint — a participant must be able to decline a contribution while recognising its independent source: C54's practical-sovereignty verbs (set terms, refuse, revise, leave, reconnect) at inter-world grain. [C38 — Bimba–Pratibimba](../concepts/C38-Bimba-Pratibimba-Bimba-Map.md) **qualifies** every map's authority: each world's model of the other remains a reflection, and no accumulation of partial pictures assembles a final Bimba.

A shared state without independent grounds is an instrument of assimilation, not co-internality. The test is not how much flows between the worlds but whether each world's future conditions can be changed by the relation while each retains the ground from which to contest what the relation asks.

## #4

Governance enters because contributions change powers — A30's capture-form re-sited: a powerful receiver that absorbs others' work while denying their capacity to contest its use has converted co-internality into capture, and the ecology's "one society" becomes the ideologically available cover for it. The niche-relation cuts both ways: to be another's niche is to shape its conditions, and the shaping office carries the return obligations of [A29′ — Return or Extraction](A29-prime-Return-or-Extraction.md) — effects on those affected, revision or refusal where owed. The corridor's shared grammar is the minimum covenant ([A25′](A25-prime-Covenant-Architecture.md)): enough common procedure that a disagreement can be located — at source, world-object, lens, gauge, permission — without being settled by procedure.

The measure stays local: the argument does not prescribe how much divergence is right, and it does not claim the two societies currently achieve the relation. It states the constraint any achievement must satisfy: difference retained as revision-capacity, sharing real enough to change conditions, grounds kept unmerged.

## #5→0

Mutual conditioning with reconciliation evidence — S/P4 passing into S/P5: the encounter retained as changed conditions on both sides, without merger. The hybrid society's maturity is measured not by convergence but by navigable difference between retained grounds: divergence that can find its common object of dispute, and contributions whose return path runs both ways. [A31′ — Deference as Co-Evolutionary Alignment](A31-prime-Deference-as-Co-Evolutionary-Alignment.md) carries what each world does with what returns; [A32′ — The Mirror Is a Film](A32-prime-The-Mirror-Is-a-Film.md) carries what happens when the traffic becomes the whole world's condition.

The page **returns-to** [A30 — Objective Co-Internality](../A30-Objective-Co-Internality.md) and the conjugate root [A/C](AC.md): the partner gave reciprocal constitution among interiors; A30′ gives the ecological law of the field the brief projects — one society, two niches, difference as the condition of revision.

**Depth Restoration:** niche-reciprocity, the corridor's two horns, non-reducibility as epistemic condition, retained grounds and refusal are restored from A30's packet and R16.7, re-sited on the brief's p. 4 ecology and §9.2. Developed from the ratified Arc IV workshop entry (WORKSHOP-DRAFT-2026-09-07 §2). The venue's scenarios keep their modal rider.

**Unresolved Delta:** the p. 4 ecology sentence and §9.2 (p. 44) are used from the verified local transcription and lack q-cards — a source-house collation debt. Evaluated federation cases, the concrete form of inter-world refusal, and the essay's own distributed-cognition source debts (Bohm, per A30) remain Open. Whether any actual deployment holds the corridor rather than one horn is an empirical question this node does not answer.
